newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FOCUS - Hoogovens H1 profit jumps 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - Hoogovens H1 profit jumps 40 pct.

text.p: Dutch steel and aluminium maker Hoogovens on Wednesday posted a 40 percent increase in first half net profit and said full year results should also show a strong increase.
Net profit for the first half was 194 million guilders against 139 million in the same period of last year, the result of high sales and an improved product mix for both steel and aluminium.
The company added it expected a "strong increase" in net profits for the whole year, with a healthier economy offering scope for price increases in the second half.
Net profit from ordinary activities in the first half reached 178 million guilders, against analysts forecasts of 162-205 million guilders and consensus of 186 million guilders.
The net profit included an unspecified extraordinary gain of 13 million guilders.
Shares in the group initially jumped nearly five percent to a high of 142.30 guilders, but just as quickly reversed direction, standing 5.00 guilders down at 131.00 by 1317 GMT.
